teaser_copy.seo_description: A charged portrait series blending neo-expressionist marks with surreal atmosphere and cyberpunk industrial textures—glow, glitch, and high contrast emotion.

tile_text: Expressionist marks meet cyberpunk glow and glitch
High contrast palettes for charged emotion

page_copy.pattern: Neo-expressionism thrives on raw gesture, high contrast, and emotional immediacy; cyberpunk adds industrial grit and luminous tech artifacts.
page_copy.action: A generative pass set base forms and palette, then in painting layered mark making, glow discipline, and glitch texture to heighten tension and mood.
page_copy.measured: Produces striking tiles and cohesive panels that read viscerally in grids and hold depth for print, social showcases, and provenance linked digital editions.
